In terms of von Willebrand disease ( VWD ) diagnosis, which statement is correct ?
(1)The platelet binding activity of VWF ( eg VWF:GPIbM, VWF:GPIbR ) is over the VWF
ristocetin cofactor assay ( VWF:RCo).
(2)For patients with a high probability of VWF ( e.g. affected first degree relative ),
bleeding assessment tool such as bleeding score can be relied on to decide whether to
order specific blood testings.
(3)VWF  level  <  0.5  IU/mL,  regardless  of  bleeding,  type  1  VWD  diagnosis  can  be
confirmed.
(4)Demopressin trial with 1- and 4- hour postinfusion blood work for VWF antigen and
activity to confirm the increased clearance of VWF for patients with VWD suspected of
type 1C.

一名過去無特別病史的 30 歲女性，因為在生產 6 個月後全身出現多處瘀血來到急診，抽血結
果如下：Platelet 135 K/μL，PT/INR: 1.1, APTT 95 s. 下列選項何者正確？
(1)最可能的原因為產生 anti-factor IX 自體抗體
(2)Emicizumab  可以有效止血並降低出血風險
(3)因為疾病復發機率很高，病患未來應避免再懷孕
(4)止血的同時應開始類固醇或其他免疫抑制劑治療

About von Willebrand disease (VWD), please choose the right statements.
(1)Type 1 VWD, the most common variant, is characterized by VWF that is abnormal in
structure and function
(2)Type 2A VWD is caused by mutations clustered within the VWF A1 domain, in a
segment critical for binding to the platelet glycoprotein Ib receptor
(3)Type 2B VWD is associated with selective loss of the largest and most functionally
active VWF multimers
(4)Response to DDAVP is generally poor in type 3 and some type 2 VWD variants

治療骨髓纖維化症 myelofibrosis 藥物有許多種，下列相關的療效及副作用敘述何者是正確的?
(1) Fedratinib 有可能發生 Wernicke's encephalopathy
(2) Spleen size reduction 比較顯著的藥是 ruxolitinib、fedratinib
(3) 病患有顯著貧血的選擇為 pacritinib、momelotinib
(4) 血小板低下症者建議選擇 fedratinib

Which of the following statements about Transfusion-Dependent Thalassemia (TDT) are correct?
(1) Thalassemia intermedia requires regular transfusions similar to TDT.
(2) TDT is characterized by transfusion-dependent anemia, requiring more than eight red cell transfusions per year.
(3) TDT symptoms typically present at around 2 years of age.
(4) The clinical phenotype of thalassemia major is historically the most severe form and is now categorized under TDT.
(5) Inadequate red cell transfusions in TDT lead to typical bone abnormalities caused by increased erythropoiesis.

下列有關 von Willebrand Factor (vWF)的敘述，何者正確？
(1) vWF 會和第 8 因子結合，延長第 8 因子的半衰期
(2) vWF 主要儲存在內皮細胞的 Weibel-Palade bodies 和血小板的 dense granule
(3) Desmopressin 可以刺激內皮細胞內的 vWF 釋放至血液
(4) 和其他血型的人相比，血型為 O 型的人體內有較高的 vWF 濃度

肥大細胞 mast cell 病變或稱 systemic mastocytosis 有許多類型及特徵，下列敘述何者正確?
(1) Total serum tryptase 上升，>20 ng/mL
(2) Mast cell markers are CD117+, also aberrant expression CD25+, CD2, CD30
(3) 最重要的基因突變為 KIT D816V
(4) 常伴有皮膚病變 urticaria pigmentosa，PB 中多見 basophilia、少見 anemia，此型預後佳（如 SM-CMML，預後比照 low risk MDS）

異體骨髓移植有許多可以改進成績處，例如減少復發、改善 GVHD，下列何者是正確的?
(1) Down regulation of HLA class II molecule 會增加復發機會
(2) Microbiota 經由增加 LCN2+ neutrophil 在小腸的浸潤，引發 macrophage 分泌 IL-10，改善 late aGVHD
(3) Adoptive T cell therapy 可以改善骨髓之 specific T cell exhaustion，它通常發生於 leukemia relapse 之前
(4) Ruxolitinib 可以改善 aGVHD、cGVHD，但是依據 REACH-2 trial 它不能改善 failure free survival
Which statement is True for acute myeloid leukemia with cytogenetic abnormalities or mutations?

下列有關 Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) 之敘述，何者正確？
(1)產生 anti-ADAMTS13 antibody  為成人發生 TTP 的主要原因

(2)使用 Ticlopidine 會增加發生 TTP 的機率，如有發生應立即停藥

(3)診斷後應立即開始血漿置換和免疫抑制藥物治療

(4)Caplacizumab 可以替代 ADAMTS13 的功能以達到治療 TTP 的效果
